prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic high-fashion underwater editorial of an adult woman suspended in clear deep teal water in an elegant fully clothed arcing movement. Her long hair streams upward toward dramatic surface rays, her eyes are closed in a peaceful expression, and she wears a champagne satin gown whose full skirt billows wide like a luminous flower. Keep both nude studded stilettos securely worn on her feet. Compose a full-body vertical shot from below with a 24mm lens at f/4, bright surface beams, ripple caustics on the gown, tiny bubbles, deep teal shadows, aquamarine light, and a luminous champagne-gold fabric finish. Preserve an ethereal, transcendent underwater-couture mood without text or logos.
